tagline: The World's Leading Movie Exhibition Company
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted EBITDA is the key profitability KPI for AMC, reflecting operational performance amid a complex financial restructuring context

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Operational profitability metric adjusted for non-recurring items
kpis.description: Consolidated adjusted EBITDA reflecting AMC and Muvico's operational performance

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated total revenue including ticketing, concessions, and other theatrical revenues
kpis.description: Consolidated total revenue from all theatrical activities

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Consolidated net loss after taxes and financial charges
kpis.description: Consolidated net loss reflecting high financial charges and restructuring costs

kpis.name: Number of Cinemas
kpis.explanation: Total number of cinemas operated by AMC in the United States and Europe
kpis.description: Total number of cinemas operated, including AMC Group and Muvico Group

kpis.name: Number of Screens
kpis.explanation: Total number of movie screens operated
kpis.description: Total number of screens operated across the AMC network

kpis.name: Attendance
kpis.explanation: Total number of moviegoers hosted in AMC cinemas
kpis.description: Total number of attendees at screenings in 2025

kpis.name: Average Ticket Price
kpis.explanation: Average price paid per attendee for admission
kpis.description: Consolidated average ticket price reflecting geographic and product mix

risks.title: Liquidity Risk and Restructuring
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned at the beginning of the document (Item 1A) with strong language ('total loss of their investment', 'restructuring of our liabilities'). It is weighted under the 'Capital' category and the severity of its potential consequences.

risks.title: High Leverage and Liquidity Constraints
risks.score_rationale: This risk is strongly emphasized in the text ('substantial level of indebtedness', 'current liquidity constraints') and directly impacts repayment capacity and investment opportunities. The 'Capital' category is relevant and the severity is high.

risks.title: Changes in the Film Industry and Competition
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed with several factors such as streaming, reduced exclusivity windows, and lower film production. It is classified as 'Industrial' with high severity.

risks.title: Extreme Stock Volatility and Dilution
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions 'significant recent dilution' and 'extreme volatility' of shares, with direct impact on price and investor value. The 'Capital' category is appropriate and the severity is significant.

risks.title: Information Systems and Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: 'Failures, unavailability or security breaches of our information systems' are mentioned as an operational risk. The 'Cybersecurity' category is most relevant, with moderate but potentially impactful severity.

risks.title: Dependence on Key Personnel and Talent Retention
risks.score_rationale: 'Dependence on key personnel' and the ability to 'attract and retain senior executives' are identified as an operational risk. The 'Key Person' category is direct, and the severity is moderate.

risks.title: Global Economic Conditions and Inflation
risks.score_rationale: 'General and international economic, political, regulatory, social and financial market conditions, including potential economic recession, inflation' are cited as regulatory risks but impact audience discretionary spending. The 'Macro' category is more appropriate, with high severity.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in AMC's 10-K filing.
